about.thirdPartyIntro: SnoutData Studio is built on open source software. Each package it includes is listed below with its licence, after Studio's own notice.
about.noLicenceFile: This build carries no licence file. A build from source writes it with "npm run build".
about.tagline: Your databases, your data, your projects, your agent. One app.
about.intro: A desktop workbench for everything around your data. Query relational, document, vector and cloud log stores in SQL or their own language, watch them with live monitors, and see a schema as a map. Build data flows that pull from files, PDFs, web pages, cloud storage and other databases. Run SnoutData projects in your own Docker or in SnoutData Cloud, and move a database between any two of them.
about.agent: Bring the coding agent you already use: it works through the app and never receives your credentials, which stay {place}. A model is called only where it is needed.

cliSignIn.scope: Allowing creates that access token. Your sign-in itself is not handed over, and you can revoke the token any time with `snoutdata tokens revoke` or from the dashboard. This prompt is a courtesy rather than a lock: any program running as you on this computer can already read what SnoutData Studio keeps here.
